settings.heading: Viha Handmade Soaps & Cosmetics
settings.subtext: Handmade soaps, shampoos, gels, face packs, talcum powders and perfumes, with skin and hair care from the Viha range.

settings.title: Handmade Soaps
settings.description: Handmade herbal soaps from the Viha range, including Neem Tulsi (neem and holy basil), Sandal, Vettiver (vetiver) and Turmeric soaps, plus shampoo bars.

settings.title: Shampoos
settings.description: Viha shampoos, including rosemary, hibiscus, onion, shikakai (soap pod) and arappu (Albizia leaf powder) shampoos, plus a shampoo bar for dry hair.

settings.title: Perfumes & Attars
settings.description: Perfumes and athar (traditional perfume oil) sets, including a sandal, kewra, rose and jasmine set, and natural jasmine oil.

settings.title: Face Packs
settings.description: Herbal face pack powders from the Viha range. Each listing gives its ingredients and how it is traditionally used.

settings.title: Cleanse
settings.description: Begin with a Viha handmade herbal soap, such as the Neem Tulsi, Sandal or Vettiver (vetiver) soap.

settings.title: Scrub
settings.description: Choose a Viha herbal bath powder or the Vetiver (vettiver) bath scrub, used as described on the listing.

settings.title: Oil
settings.description: Pick a herbal oil (thailam) from the Viha range, such as Kungumadhi Thailam. Each listing explains how the oil is traditionally used.

settings.title: Finish
settings.description: Close with a gel or cream from the Skin Care range, such as Organic Aloe Vera Gel. Follow the directions on each listing.

settings.heading: A Simple Beauty Ritual
settings.subtext: A four-step routine built from products in the Viha range: soap, bath powder or scrub, oil and gel. Directions for each product are on its listing.

settings.title: Kumkumadi
settings.description: A traditional oil (thailam) with a saffron and sesame base. Shop the Viha Kungumadhi Thailam for dry or oily skin.

settings.title: Neem
settings.description: Neem (veppilai) is a tree long used in Indian households and Ayurvedic tradition. Shop soap, gel, oil, powder and dried neem bark and flower.

settings.title: Turmeric
settings.description: Manjal (turmeric), including wild turmeric (kasturi manjal), is traditionally used in South Indian skincare rituals. Shop powders and a handmade soap.

settings.title: Sandalwood
settings.description: Sandalwood (chandan) and red sandalwood are traditional fragrant woods used in face packs and rituals. Shop powders, soap and talcum.

settings.title: Vetiver
settings.description: Vettiver (vetiver, also called khus) is a root traditionally valued for its cooling, earthy aroma. Shop powder, soap, scrub and talcum.
